decisions.quote: Only one published study has focused specifically on the effectiveness of IF for children with autism, and demonstrated that the inclusion of IF resulted in more efficient teaching during 1:1 instruction for four preschoolers with autism/developmental delay. The current pair of studies seeks to replicate and extend the findings of Reichow and Wolery.
